name: document-view-tracker
description: Proof-of-concept document view tracking system with Express backend and React dashboard

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix frontend && node backend/server.js"
